item.title: Blocked road gully causing ongoing flooding, Sumner Road, 23rd October
item.description:
The road gully on Sumner Road, just off Peckham High Street, is blocked. Rainwater is not draining properly, causing a large pool of standing water to form along the kerb and extend into the road whenever it rains. This issue was previously reported on 5 February 2026 (FixMyStreet ref: 8848986), but the problem remains unresolved. Could the council please arrange for the gully to be cleared and the drainage inspected to prevent further flooding? This is a reoccurring issue and creates a potential hazard for pedestrians, cyclists and other road users.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 29, Peckham High Street, Peckham, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Street cleaning and unblocking drains, 23rd October
item.description:
I’ve previously emailed regarding the state of my road. We had a mudslide from a burst pipe on a hill near our street back in July that’s blocked drains and mud is still present in the road. Surrounding roads have been cleared of leaves since I messaged back in the beginning of September but yet we still are waiting. We have no drainage on our road and with the current rainfall my home is at risk of flooding. I understand that as there’s no permits needed to park on my road we do get a lot of parked cars there but surely the council can put a no parking in place so the mud under cars and the drains can be cleared. When I last emailed I was sent a reply stating the detris can be cleared up to 5 weeks after an event but the mudslide was in July and we are still waiting for the remaining mud to be cleared and the drains that have been blocked since the same time to be cleared.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Kingswood Drive, Dulwich, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
